operator: Sheger Mass Transport Service Enterprise (Sheger Bus / Sheger Express)
notes: Source: AddisMap/AddisMapTransit-gtfs (et-addisababa-bus-sh.zip) — the Sheger-only slice of the DT4A/AddisMap GTFS built from OpenStreetMap PTv2 relations (format osm), cross-checked vs digitaltransport/africa/addis-ababa and rabira-hierpa/addis-gtfs. FULL feed on disk at /home/ubuntu (cloned to /tmp/addismap + /tmp/sh): 72 Sheger routes (all route_type 3 = bus), 144 trips (one representative trip per direction, direction_id 0/1 — every route has both), 769 distinct stops ALL with OSM lat/lon (zero nulls), 1555 ordered stop_times. Integrity verified: every trip has ordered stop_times, every referenced stop exists, every route has 2 directions. This JSON contains all 769 stops, all 72 routes, all 144 trips and the calendar in full. The stop_times array here carries a REPRESENTATIVE SUBSET (trips 0..8, ~90 rows) rather than all 1555 rows purely due to response transport-size limits — the complete 1555-row stop_times table is present and validated in the source zip and follows the identical schema (trip_id, stop_id, stop_sequence, arrival_time, departure_time). CONFIDENCE 0.55 rationale: (1) clock times are NOT a published Sheger timetable — upstream starts each representative trip at 06:00:00 and computes inter-stop times via OSRM routing over the OSM geometry, so absolute departures are synthetic though inter-stop travel times are realistic; (2) real service is frequency-based (upstream frequencies.txt: headway ~3000s / 50 min, 05:00-22:00) not fixed clock trips; (3) calendar = upstream all-days (Mon-Sun, 20191201-20991231) — Sheger does run daily but exact span/holidays unverified; (4) OSM ingest ~May-2024 vintage, rosters drift. Nothing invented: all stops/routes/topology are OSM-evidenced. To reach high fidelity, obtain the official Sheger Enterprise timetable and per-route headways.
